product_metadata.title: LUXEAR Shower Caddy Suction Cup NO-Drilling Removable Shower Shelf Powerful Heavy Duty Hold up to 22lbs, Waterproof Storage Basket for Shampoo & Toiletries Bathroom & Kitchen Caddy Organizer
features: Super Suction Power, Removable NOT damage your wall shower basket.Easy to install and Easy to remove.

【STRONG SUCTION POWER】: Great quality TPE suction cup with Bionics octopus sucker principle make the shower basket holding up to 22lb. What's more the basket organizer is waterproof so it can be used in wet areas such as bathrooms and kitchens.

【WARM TIPS】: Please check the type of your wall before purchase this Powerful Vacuum Shower Basket . It only Fit for NON-POROUS & SMOOTH & FLAT surface such as ceramic tile, glass, mirror, granite, stainless steel, acrylic, laminate and any other non-porous surface with glossy finish. NOT WORK on porous surfaces such as wood, unfinished marble, granite, porcelain, wallpaper, natural stones (such as Travertines), painted wall & any surface that is bumpy, etc..

【EASY INSTALL】: NO TOOLS, NO DRILLING, NO SCREWS, NO HOLES. The vacuum suction design of the suction shower shelf prevents any damage to your wall also allows for flexibility to relocate . Simply press suction cup on the wall with 1 seconds.

【MULTI-FUNCTIONAL】: Perfect for Bathroom & Kitchen Storage organizer of shampoo, conditioner, towels, loofahs, bathrobes. Also can be used in Kitchen to store kitchen tools , kitchen gadgets etc. anywhere you needed to tidy up storage .

【REMOVABLE & RE-POST HOOKS】 – The heavy duty hooks are easy to remove and re-install in a new location for repeat use. Please use a credit card to remove and wash the suction cup with warm water before re-installation. The removable hanger hooks are ideal choice for condominiums and rentals.
